text:
You need someone who can tighten on-page tags and measurement so your pages are easier to find, better organized, and more effective at driving organic traffic.  

I’m Mina Castellan, and I bring 5 years of experience in data analysis, dashboarding, and structured optimization work using SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets. While my background is analytics rather than pure SEO, I’ve worked on data-heavy projects where precision, taxonomy, and performance tracking mattered. For example, in my Marketing attribution analysis for Verdant Skincare, I built a BigQuery model joining ad spend with GA4 sessions to compare attribution models, which helped reallocate 18% of ad budget. In my GA4 migration and tracking plan, I built the tracking plan and GTM setup for 46 events with no gap in year-on-year reporting.  

I’d be glad to support keyword-led on-page improvements, tag structure, and performance analysis.
